kebab_example: aliyun vs create-template --name '录制模板' --type record --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTemplate

parameters.help_en: Template Name
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: Template description
parameters.help_zh: 模板描述
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Template type. Valid values:  
record (recording)  
snapshot (snapshot)  
transcode (transcoding)  
timeshift (time shifting)
parameters.help_zh:
模板类型。取值：
record（录制）
snapshot（截图）
transcode（转码）
timeshift（时移）
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: Region where the OSS bucket resides, that is, the service center.
parameters.help_zh: OSS所属区域，即服务中心
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: OSS bucket
parameters.help_zh: OSS的Bucket
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: Domain name of OSS.
parameters.help_zh: OSS的域名
parameters.name: oss_endpoint

parameters.help_en: OSS file prefix.
parameters.help_zh: OSS文件前缀
parameters.name: oss_file_prefix

parameters.help_en:
Template trigger type. Default value: auto. Valid values:  
auto (automatic)  
ondemand (on-demand)
parameters.help_zh:
模板触发类型，默认auto。取值：
auto（自动）
ondemand（按需）
parameters.name: trigger

parameters.help_en: Operation epoch, in seconds.
parameters.help_zh: 操作周期，单位秒
parameters.name: interval

parameters.help_en: Time-shift retention period, in days
parameters.help_zh: 时移保存周期，单位：天
parameters.name: retention

parameters.help_en:
Storage file format. Multiple values are separated by commas. Valid values:
mp4
flv
hls
The Qingdao ingest endpoint does not support recording in FLV or MP4 formats
parameters.help_zh:
存储文件格式，多值用逗号分隔。取值：
mp4
flv
hls
青岛单元暂不支持flv、mp4录制
parameters.name: file_format

parameters.help_en:
Storage path for JPG files used in overwrite snapshots.  
Only JPG images are currently supported.  
Supports variable substitution with {AppName} and {StreamName}.
parameters.name: jpg_overwrite

parameters.help_en:
Storage path for JPG files used in sequential snapshots.  
Only JPG images are currently supported.  
Supports variable substitution with {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.  
Either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence} is required.
parameters.help_zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于序列截图。
目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
parameters.name: jpg_sequence

parameters.help_en:
Storage path for on-demand JPG screenshots.
Only JPG images are currently supported.
Variables can be used in the path. Supported variables include {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
Either {UnixTimestamp} or {Sequence} must be included
parameters.help_zh:
JPG的存储路径，用于按需截图。
目前仅支持生成jpg图片。
支持变量匹配，包含{AppName}、{StreamName}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}
{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}必填一个
parameters.name: jpg_on_demand

parameters.help_en:
Storage path for MP4 files.  
The path supports variable substitution. Available variables include {AppName}, {StreamName}, {Sequence}, {EscapedStartTime}, and {EscapedEndTime}.  
{EscapedStartTime} and {EscapedEndTime} are required.
parameters.name: mp4

parameters.help_en: Storage path for FLV files. For the format, see the description for Mp4.
parameters.help_zh: FLV的存储路径。格式参考Mp4说明
parameters.name: flv

parameters.help_en: Storage path for HLS m3u8 files. For the format, see the description for Mp4.
parameters.help_zh: HLS的存储路径，m3u8文件。格式参考Mp4说明
parameters.name: hls_m3u8

parameters.help_en:
Storage path for HLS .ts files.
Variables can be used in the path. Supported variables include {AppName}, {StreamName}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
The variables {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} must both be included
parameters.name: hls_ts

parameters.help_en:
Callback URL to be invoked after template execution.  

Note: Templates triggered on demand do not support callback parameters.
parameters.help_zh:
模板执行后的回调。

注： 按需触发的模板不支持回调参数
parameters.name: callback

parameters.help_en: An array of TransConfig-type transcoding configurations, formatted as a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 转码配置TransConfig类型的数组，JSON格式字符串
parameters.name: trans_configs_json
